open-datum VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: open-datum holding COMMAND

Update a live payload or book permanent termination

The controller chooses one live holding by its output reference. An update
replaces only its payload. Termination donates its protected deposit
immediately and leaves a request for any wallet to fold; the termination
cannot be reclaimed.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  update      Replace the payload of a live holding       
  terminate   Book permanent termination of a live holding
